description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeLeaveBalanceSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM Leave module. The class extends LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams and includes a trait DateRangeSearchFilterParamsTrait. It encapsulates filter parameters for searching employee leave balances, specifically including an employee number property with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveBalanceSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for filtering employee leave balance search results, including employee number and date range filters.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used as a filter criterion.
